synopsis: Several town boards and committees prepared for the upcoming Fall Town Meeting by reviewing warrant articles, project costs, and zoning proposals. The Community Preservation Committee and Trails Committee advanced funding discussions for the Peninsula Trail footbridge and the Southborough Golf Club irrigation system. Meanwhile, the Zoning Board of Appeals finalized its support for a two-family dwelling warrant article, and conservation and library panels addressed local permits and preliminary budget previews.

highlights.title: Peninsula Trail and Golf Club Funding Requests Advanced
highlights.why: The Community Preservation Committee reviewed warrant articles for Fall Town Meeting, including an additional $217,318 request for the Peninsula Trail footbridge and $433,546 for the Southborough Golf Club irrigation system replacement.

highlights.title: Two-Family Dwelling Warrant Article Supported
highlights.why: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted unanimously to support the town meeting warrant article regarding two-family dwelling provisions as drafted, opting against last-minute changes to minimum lot requirements.

highlights.title: Conservation Commission Lifts 2013 Enforcement Order
highlights.why: The commission voted to lift an old enforcement order for 6 Limbrook Road after confirming that unpermitted masonry work was resolved and no active erosion exists, while continuing various project hearings.

highlights.title: Library Board Reviews FY28 Budget Preview
highlights.why: The Library Board of Trustees examined preliminary FY28 budget comparisons, staff longevity payouts, and CWMARS network rules regarding state certification requirements.

looking_ahead.what: Planning Board meeting regarding Master Plan implementation
Continued public hearings for Overlook Drive, Marlborough Junction, and Southville Road projects
